@buywhere/mcp-server.overview:
## BuyWhere MCP Server

Open-source MCP server for AI agent commerce. Search 50M+ products across 6 markets.

**Key features:**
- 50M+ products across SG, MY, TH, US, ID, AU
- Hybrid FTS + vector search for accurate product matching
- find_similar tool for cross-merchant price comparison
- Free API tier (1K requests/month) for individual developers
